escalations.why: risk.Drawdown in docs/packages/risk/contract.md is 'ticker: str; depth: float; peak_date: str', but RISK-05 (spec.md:34) requires the date of the trough too, REP-01 (spec.md:41) writes 'both dates' into the report, M1-T20 acceptance says 'TC-08 passes: depth within 1e-12, both dates exact', and tests/fixtures/risk/TC-08/expected.json carries a trough_date per ticker. Freezing the type as contract.md states it would leave M1-T20 and TC-08 unsatisfiable; adding the field myself would make the interface differ from contract.md. Proposed Revise: 'Drawdown: ticker: str; depth: float; peak_date: str; trough_date: str' with invariant 'peak_date <= trough_date; both equal the first date (returns.base_date) when there is no fall'.

Real mdata.load_prices ignores tickers: validate_rows (packages/mdata/src/mdata/validate.py) only raises KeyError for a missing requested ticker and returns every ticker's rows, while the frozen fakes (tests/contracts/mdata.load_prices/fake.py, risk.vol_series/fake.py) select the result to the requested tickers 'as in the real function'; the contract text for load_prices/validate_rows never says tickers selects, so the M1-T21 system test risk_report(csv, out, tickers=['Y']) returns X and Y. Fix: state in contract.md that tickers restricts the rows (and so the calendar) to those tickers, and have validate_rows keep only requested tickers (task owning mdata.validate); M1-T21's tests/system/test_e2e.py and tests/unit/risk/test_risk_report.py already assert it
